Hithium HeroEE 16 16kWh Lithium Solar Battery

The Hithium HeroEE 16 16kWh Lithium Solar Battery is a premium-grade power backup solution engineered for both residential and small commercial applications, offering unmatched performance, reliability, and energy efficiency. With an output capacity of 10240W and an advanced 10 kVA inverter, this system can simultaneously run a wide range of household and office appliances, including 10 LED lights, 6 ceiling fans, a refrigerator, microwave oven, 4 air coolers or 2 air conditioners, as well as laptops, desktops, smart TVs, washing machines, irons, kettles, printers, CCTV systems, Wi-Fi routers, sound systems, and even residential lifts. Designed for extended use, the Hithium HeroEE 16 16kWh Lithium Battery features a high-capacity 16000Wh battery that delivers up to 5 hours of uninterrupted backup time, making it ideal for areas with frequent power outages. Built with longevity in mind, the Hithium HeroEE 16 Lithium Battery utilizes ultra-durable battery cells with an outstanding 11,000 cycle life and an expected minimum lifespan of 25 years, significantly reducing long-term replacement and maintenance costs. The system supports dual charging options both solar and AC electricity allowing flexible and eco-friendly energy sourcing in any environment. For added peace of mind, the Hithium HeroEE 16 10240W Solar Battery includes comprehensive safety features such as overcharge and over-discharge protection, overcurrent protection, overload protection, short circuit protection, and full fault detection systems, ensuring both device and user safety at all times. Whether you’re looking to secure your home from outages or power your small business with a sustainable energy solution, the Hithium HeroEE 16 10240W 16kWh delivers industrial-grade power in a smart, compact, and highly efficient design.

Solis IntelliHome-5kWh-OD 51.2V 100Ah Solar Battery

The Solis IntelliHome-5kWh-OD 51.2V 100Ah Solar Battery is an advanced Solar Battery designed for residential and commercial solar energy storage systems. The Solis IntelliHome-5kWh-OD LiFePO4 Battery features an IP66-rated enclosure and C5M corrosion protection for demanding outdoor environments. The Solis IntelliHome-5kWh-OD 51.2V Inverter Battery measures 470 × 650 × 150mm and weighs 50kg. It operates within an ambient temperature range of -20°C to 55°C, subject to specified temperature-related derating. The battery meets several recognized safety and transportation standards, including IEC 62619 and UN 38.3. It supports selected Solis inverters, so compatibility should be confirmed before installation. For customers seeking a durable Lithium Battery, this 100AH battery offers expandable capacity, intelligent battery management, and reliable energy storage for compatible solar installations.

Wide Inverter Compatibility and Certified Safety

The Solis IntelliHome-16kWh-OD 314Ah Lithium Battery pairs with many Solis S6, S5, and SS inverters. Always check your inverter model against the official compatibility list first. The Must LP16-24100 25.6V 100Ah UPS Battery is a high-capacity lithium power source. Designed to provide high performance, a long lifespan, and exceptional dependability in modern power systems. With a nominal voltage of 25.6V and a capacity of 100Ah, it provides 2560Wh of clean energy at a maximum output power of 2.5KW. The battery is designed for endurance, with over 6000 cycles at 80% depth of discharge (DOD) at 25°C, ensuring long-term value and constant performance for years. The Must LP16-24100 25.6V UPS Battery supports a variety of installation modes, including wall-mounted, stacked, and rack-mounted configurations, allowing users to create efficient energy storage systems that are specific to their requirements. It also supports the CAN2.0, RS232, and RS485 communication protocols, ensuring interoperability with hybrid inverters and advanced energy management solutions. The Must LP16-24100 100Ah UPS Battery is designed for adaptability and performance, with a rugged SPCC steel casing and an IP21 protection grade that ensures long-lasting durability and heat resistance. It operates optimally throughout a wide temperature range, charging from 0°C to 50°C and discharging from -20°C to 60°C. The suggested charge voltage is 29.2V, with a discharge cutoff of 22V, to ensure safe and efficient energy consumption. This Must Battery for UPS provides outstanding reliability with little maintenance, making it suitable for applications such as domestic solar ESS, commercial backup power, and off-grid systems.
